item.title: Fitness activities tracker
item.description: Small Laravel web project to track daily user’s fitness activities. Features # User registration and login. General listing of all activities. Filter by type option (cycling, running, swimming…). Online form to add new activities. Tech features # Request form data validation on new activity. Data cache system on public dashboard. Observer to trigger update cache on new fitness activity.

item.title: Room's CO2 level monitoring
item.description: English: #A monitoring device has been deployed to estimate the CO2 concentration as well to track the occupancy in indoor environments. Data measured by the device installed in a room is sent to an internet server and stored in a database. Remote users have real-time access to the measurements and track records of the rooms through a web application created and accessible via web.

item.title: Health insurance system
item.description: Online web application developed in PHP, Mysql using the Laravel framework. Allows you to manage the monitoring of a health insurance booking process. Features # Administration panel: Profiles of administrators, agents and clients with different operating permissions. Administrator has permissions to: Add, modify, delete agents, insurances companies, clients, doctors/laboratories and offices.

item.title: Membership club management
item.description: Online web application developed in PHP and Mysql using Laravel framework. It allows you to manage invoices payments history and generate new recurring invoices of member’s club. Features: Features # Add, modify, delete partners. Add, modify, delete recurring campaign or event. Create, modify, delete new recurring invoices pending payment from each member or on specific events.

item.title: Audit computer equipment
item.description: Auditing computer equipment involves systematically reviewing and assessing hardware and software assets within an organization to ensure they meet operational standards, security protocols, and compliance requirements. Backend and frontend development of web application in PHP and Mysql using the Laravel framework. Create a system that allows to audit computer’s equipment performance of companies generating a web report and a pdf file of equipments analyzed.

item.title: Realtime ordering system in kitchen of restaurant
item.description:
Online web application developed in PHP using Laravel framework for managing real-time kitchen orders in a restaurant. It allows, through a web panel, real-time communication (WebSockets) between chefs and waiters about the status of orders.

Features #

  1. System of registration and identification of restaurant workers.
  2. Three operational roles:
  • Administrator: absolute control over registered worker accounts, active / deactivated account status and account type (administrator, waiter, chef).
  • Waiter: operation on products and stock, taking orders and change of status “Annotate order -> Pending” or “Ready -> Delivered”.
  • Chef: operation on change of order status Pending -> Ready and change of product status to “no stock”.
  1. Real-time notification system using websockets through pop-up windows to notify chefs about new orders or notify waiters when the order is ready in the kitchen.

View screenshots and download
